feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 11:49am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 23 October 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Heavy rain at first this afternoon will turn lighter and patchier before clearing later. Quite windy with a strong to gale force northwesterly wind, with top temperature around 11°C.

This evening will be dry with clear spells as the wind backs to the west or northwest and decreases fresh to strong. It will then remain dry for much of the night before it turns cloudy towards dawn as further rain arrives from the west. Minimum temperature around 8°C.


##Outlook##

The rain will become heavy again tomorrow morning as the wind backs to the south and increases to gale force. The rain will then clear later in the afternoon as the wind turns to the west or southwest, before increasing to severe gale force during the evening, giving gusts of 60-70mph overnight into Sunday, causing some damage and disruption to travel. Maximum temperature around 14°C.

Sunday will be bright with sunny spells and only isolated showers, but still very windy with severe gale force west to south-westerly winds, which will ease slightly during the morning, although remaining gale force until evening, before a more significant decrease overnight into Monday.
